speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
text: We will continue to review and if necessary calibrate our support, so that all Singaporeans can upskill and reskill throughout life.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Again, I thank the good Senior Minister of State, for his comprehensive reply.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I seek some indulgence and flexibility from the Senior Minister of State in relation to this group of professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) who are extremely specialised.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: They have done their post graduate studies, possibly PhDs, and they have sort of pigeonholed themselves into a specialisation.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: AI disruption comes and pulls the rug from under their feet, and then, they really have to reinvent themselves.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: And the view, and I will come to my supplementary, Sir —

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Mr de Souza, get to your supplementary questions quickly.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: The view is that they need this extra support beyond what the fees allow them, or the subsidies allow them to retrain.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: So, can there be some flexibility injected into the review mechanism, for how much uplift they can get in terms of their subsidies?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We are always looking at how we will review these mechanisms of support.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: And I would say that the overall intent of what we are trying to do with SkillsFuture as a movement, is very much aligned with what Mr de Souza identified for this particular set of PMETs who have had very specialised skills which have been disrupted.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Actually, we want the same type of ability to reboot one's career, to reinvent one's skillset and career opportunities, to be available to all Singaporeans.
